display_long_description:
Store Simulator Cosplay Shop brings the fun of shop management into virtual reality.
Step inside your own cozy, anime-inspired cosplay store and experience what it’s like to run and grow a fan-focused retail business in VR.

Inspired by classic shop and supermarket simulator games, this VR experience lets you manage products, organize shelves, decorate interiors, and serve customers, all from a first-person virtual reality perspective.

You can interact with your shop environment, place items, and manage daily operations while building the ultimate cosplay destination.

! Gameplay & Features

- Run Your Own Cosplay Store
- Stock, organize, and sell a variety of items, including:
- Cosplay masks
- Hats, glasses, and wigs
- Toys, plushies, manga, and figurines
- Clothing and cute accessories

Keep shelves filled, manage pricing, and satisfy customer needs to grow your business.

! Customize & Decorate Your Store

- Design your shop to match a cozy anime aesthetic:
- Change walls, floors, and interior layouts
- Add decorations and themed props
- Create a welcoming atmosphere for customers

! Shop Management & Economy System

- Experience a full store simulator loop in VR
- Order products and restock inventory
- Manage shelves and item placement
- Track income and store progress
- Expand your shop over time
